extended_in_place.part: YCH-F_y_chain_envelope (igus E2 medium class 38 x 18 R55)

moved_back_110: the back section: row G strip and its stations, dock base with 8 bays and tools, dock rails and posts, dock-rail base cross members, back base member, back corner uprights and feet, back top member, roof back member, back panel, the back sheets of side panels, roof and floor, the connector plane, the Y motors
steps: 1 Park the head at the front, park the tools in the dock, then take the tools out to a rack; switch off; unplug the back-section connectors at the connector plane CPL-F
2 Remove the back panel, the back sheets of the side panels, roof and floor, and the butt straps at the back-section joint
3 Lift the gantry off (two people; Y moving mass about 22 kg) or slide it to the front on its blocks

4 Unbolt the back section from the base and side members and move it back 110 mm on the extended base members (fit the 110 mm pieces with their joining plates and the new foot pair under each joint first)
5 Fit the new side beams and Y rails (replaced, never jointed); align with the rail jig RJ and a straightedge
6 Refit the gantry, fit the longer Y belts and tension them (frequency method); fit the new Y chain tray and add chain links
7 Fit the inserted row: deck strip, joint bar and its two posts, the stations of row C, F, the under-deck rail segment and the extension leads at the connector plane
8 Fit the bay sheets of the side panels, roof and floor with butt straps and gasket tape; refit the back sheets and back panel; extend the shelf

9 Re-commission: Y travel and endstops (size config), input shaping with the accelerometer, the head camera re-measures every deck place and the dock bay markers, 20 exchanges per carriage, extraction airflow switch re-proved, enclosure leak check at the new laps
S_to_M.downtime_ASSUMED: 3-4 working days (mechanical 1.5-2 days with two people, commissioning 1 day, one validation run 1 day: study)
